build_policy_factory: build a PolicyFactory instance with timestep_spec, action_spec, and a builder callable to produce policies
create_policy_factory: create a PolicyFactory that constructs bot policies from dm_env timestep and action specs
test_policy_factory_build: test the PolicyFactory build method returns a policy.Policy instance from the builder callable
review_policy_factory_timestep_spec: review the PolicyFactory timestep_spec method that returns the expected timestep spec
review_policy_factory_action_spec: review the PolicyFactory action_spec method that returns the DiscreteArray action spec
